brief.symptoms: Offsets are reset on Azure EventHubs when a consumer starts, causing the consumer to reprocess all messages from the beginning each time it joins the group.
brief.evidence:
Message received: key=, value={...}, partition=0, offset=0
Message received: key=, value={...}, partition=0, offset=1
... (repeated for every offset from the start of the topic)
restarting the consumer or adding a new one it will consume everything again
hints: The consumer reports that it has processed messages from offset 0 each time it starts.
Look at the offset commit request handling in the offset manager.
When the retention time is set to 0, the broker treats it as a special value.
brief.lesson: The fix maps Sarama's default retention value (0) to Kafka's default (-1) for offset commit requests, preventing the broker from resetting offsets on consumer group joins.
